title: ULPF Prism — Event Investigation
description: Event-to-evidence investigation with parser and Source Pack provenance.

list.name: vendor
list.label: Vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY vendor

list.name: product
list.label: Product
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT product FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY product

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY category

list.name: action
list.label: Action
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY action

list.name: severity
list.label: Severity
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT severity_label FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY severity_label

list.name: quality
list.label: Quality
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT quality_status FROM ulpf.events_v1 ORDER BY quality_status

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at, event_id, vendor, product, category, action, severity_label, source_ip, source_port, destination_ip, destination_port, quality_status, source_pack_name, source_pack_version, parser_name, parser_version, raw_sha256 FROM ulpf.events_v1 FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') AND match(product, '${product:regex}') AND match(category, '${category:regex}') AND match(action, '${action:regex}') AND match(severity_label, '${severity:regex}') AND match(quality_status, '${quality:regex}') ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT event_id, raw_event_id, raw_sha256, source_pack_name, source_pack_version, parser_name, parser_version, normalized_json FROM ulpf.events_v1 FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND match(vendor, '${vendor:regex}') ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 100
